title: CTM-AI: Evolving Multi-Agent Intelligence Inspired by a Model of Consciousness
claim: Prior work splits into theory-only and practice-only camps; ours sits at their intersection by instantiating theory as a working system.
layout: 2 overlapping tilted planes, intersection at lower right, dashed arrows converge on ours
description: A diagram of two overlapping, tilted translucent planes. The upper red plane, labeled 'Consciousness theory', holds Global Workspace Theory and the Conscious Turing Machine as red dots. The lower blue plane, labeled 'Multi-agent system', holds ChatDev, AgentNet, Agent-Omni and MetaGPT as blue dots of different sizes. The planes overlap in a darker purple-red wedge at the lower right, labeled 'Intersection'. A large dark red dot there is labeled 'CTM-AI'. Two dashed white arrows run to it. One comes from the Conscious Turing Machine and is labeled 'instantiate'. The other comes from MetaGPT and is labeled 'generalize'. Gradients fade each plane toward its far corner. The eye goes first to the strong red plane, then follows the arrows to CTM-AI.
caption: Positioning of CTM-AI. Existing research falls into two domains: models of consciousness (red) offer theoretical foundations but lack practical implementations, while multi-agent frameworks (blue) offer practical implementations but lack principled foundations. CTM-AI bridges this gap by instantiating the Conscious Turing Ma- chine as a practical AI system.
abstract: Despite remarkable advances, today's AI systems remain narrow in scope, falling short of the adaptive and continual intelligence that characterizes human capabilities. This gap has fueled longstanding debates about whether AI might one day achieve human-like generality or even consciousness. Flipping the debate, we present a concrete blueprint for a multi-agent AI system inspired by a formal machine model of consciousness called the Conscious Turing Machine (CTM). Together, CTM-AI contains a large collection of powerful processors ranging from specialized experts (e.g., language models, multimodal models, tools, and APIs) to unspecialized general-purpose learners poised to develop their own expertise. Crucially, for whatever problem must be dealt with, information from many processors is competitively selected, integrated, and exchanged appropriately to solve the task. Feedback mechanisms in CTM-AI enable the system to iteratively evolve its internal connections and communication. CTM-AI achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on MUStARD (72.28) and UR-FUNNY (72.13), outperforming multimodal and multi-agent frameworks. On tool-using and agentic tasks, CTM-AI achieves 10+ points of improvement on StableToolBench and WebArena-Lite. Overall, CTM-AI offers a principled and testable multi-agent AI system inspired by a model of consciousness. The code is available at https://github.com/consciousness-lab/ctm-ai.
